preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 100,000.

postconditions.description: If a valid tree is not possible, output '-1'. Otherwise, output n-1 lines representing the edges of the tree.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(u) <= n and 1 <= int(v) <= n for u, v in (line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: All edges must connect valid node indices between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: len(set((u, v) for u, v in (line.split() for line in stdout.splitlines()))) == n - 1
postconditions.description: All edges must be unique and form a valid tree.
